{{Quotation|game|The Great Northern Wall is the last line of defense between the beastlike [[Charr]] of the north, and the last two remaining cities of the fallen kingdom of [[Ascalon]]. Before [[the Searing]], the Northern Gate was the grand, diplomatic entrance used to greet visiting dignitaries. Now it is just another outpost, manned by the Ascalon army and citizens who volunteer for guard duty.}}

[[The Great Northern Wall (outpost)|The Great Northern Wall]] is a [[mission]] [[outpost]] along the [[Great Northern Wall]].

== Getting There ==

*The portal to the outpost is in northeast corner of [[Ascalon City]].
*The quest [[Defend the Wall]] will lead you here.

==Mission==
*[[The Great Northern Wall]]
**This mission is the first mission in the [[Prophecies campaign]] and the first mission in the [[Ascalon]] region.
